title: Discrete Variance
prompt:
X takes values [-3, 3, 2] with relative weights [1, 1, 3].

Find Var(X) = E[X²] − E[X]² as an exact fraction.
hint: compute E[X²] and E[X] from the weights, then subtract the square
recap: Var(X) = E[X^2] − E[X]^2 measures spread: the mean of the squares minus the square of the mean. It is always ≥ 0.
